name: The Legend of Cuan
source:
A little hacking never hurt, right? WRONG! As Joe soon finds out when he hacks into a government lab and releases a killer.

[From [url=https://otakuworld.com/shibai/index.html?/shibai/pages/legendofcuan.html]Otaku World[/url]]
translation:
一点点黑客攻击永远不会有坏处，对吧？错误的！当乔侵入政府实验室并释放一名杀手时，他很快就发现了这一点。

[来自[url=https://otakuworld.com/shibai/index.html?/shibai/pages/legendofcuan.html]宅男世界[/url]]
